title: Agent Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for TPU agent suite agent Markdown YAML frontmatter.

name.description: Canonical lowercase agent name, matching the .md filename.

description.description: Explanation of the agent role and routing conditions.

tools.description: Declared canonical tools ('read', 'write', 'edit', 'search', 'shell', 'web_search', 'web_fetch') or package scripts/mcp servers.

delegates.description: Names of subagents this agent is allowed to route work to.

scripts.description: Package-relative paths to executable scripts this document uses, under scripts/.

references.description: Package-relative paths to reference documents or directories this document reads, under references/. A directory brings every file under it.

accepts.description: Package-relative path to input contract JSON schema.

produces.description: Package-relative path to output contract JSON schema.

effort.description: How much the agent thinks, where the harness lets an agent definition set it (Claude Code). Other harnesses run the agent at their default.

host_dependencies.description: Python package names this document's scripts need on the host, without versions or extras (those belong in requirements-client.txt). Unioned by the compiler across the package.

tpu_dependencies.description: Python package names this document's scripts need in the TPU workload environment, without versions or extras (those belong in requirements-tpu.txt). Unioned by the compiler across the package.
